summary: Channels Source Manager context-aware columns. Preserve the accepted five-column unfiltered view, but suppress redundant Source and/or Type columns when those facets are already fixed by active filters. Reconcile structural tests so the V2.47.140 header contract accepts semantic header classes and the V2.47.142 test does not interpolate PHP variables. Runtime UI behavior remains unchanged by the reconciliation. Shared Shell, Navigation, data model, schema, migrations and updater mechanism remain unchanged. Production remains Owner manual.
